Dear Aishwarya,

We are delighted to offer you the position of Senior Backend Engineer with Meridian Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, on the Platform team reporting to Vikram Shah.

Your annual compensation will be ₹36,00,000 (Rupees Thirty-Six Lakhs), structured as fixed pay of ₹32,40,000 and a performance-linked component of ₹3,60,000. In addition, you will be covered under the company's family health insurance plan from your date of joining.

Your proposed date of joining is 1 October 2026. This offer is contingent on satisfactory completion of background verification, conducted with your consent through our verification partner.

We were genuinely impressed through every conversation in this process, and the team is excited to build with you.

Warm regards,
Rajesh Menon
HR Director, Meridian Technologies Pvt Ltd

Dear Rohan,

We are delighted to offer you the position of DevOps Engineer with Meridian Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, on the Engineering — Infrastructure team reporting to Vikram Shah.

Your annual compensation will be ₹24,00,000 (Rupees Twenty-Four Lakhs), structured as fixed pay of ₹21,60,000 and a performance-linked component of ₹2,40,000, with family health insurance from your date of joining.

Your proposed date of joining is 12 June 2026. This offer is contingent on satisfactory completion of background verification, conducted with your consent through our verification partner.

Warm regards,
Rajesh Menon
HR Director, Meridian Technologies Pvt Ltd
